title: Message/set update: unknown key returns invalidArguments not invalidProperties
description: message.rs:502 — process_update returns type: invalidArguments when a patch key other than readAt is used. RFC 8620 §5.3 requires unknown/read-only properties in an update patch to yield type: invalidProperties (a per-object SetError in notUpdated). The placement is correct (goes into notUpdated), but the type string is wrong. A client pattern-matching on error type will misclassify this. Fix: change 'invalidArguments' to 'invalidProperties' at line 502.
